playing: Move cards to build the clock faces

tutorial.clock: The twelve clock faces sit above. **♣2 is at nine o'clock** and each position clockwise starts one rank higher, ending on ♦K at eight. Each builds up in suit, wrapping king to ace.
tutorial.targets: The "→" under each face is the rank it must reach — **its own hour** (9 at nine o'clock, Q at twelve). A finished face is marked and accepts nothing more. **The twelve totals come to exactly 104**, so finishing them all uses the whole deck.
tutorial.tableau: Eight columns of five. Build **down in suit**, one card at a time. **An emptied column is never refilled.** The other 52 cards are the stock: when nothing moves, "Deal" tops every column back up to three. No redeal.
tutorial.controls: Buttons for dealing, hints, undo and auto-complete.
